user.title: Austrian tariff profile
user.description: Select the grid area and supply type. EEG tariffs apply only to allocated community energy; create a separate regular grid profile for residual supply. Scope: grid level 7, non-metered capacity, single tariff. This development version does not create price sensors yet.

tariff.title: Tariff assumptions
tariff.description: Confirm the conditions applicable to your supply. Future price values will be calculated in EUR/kWh excluding VAT.

data_description.household: Matches Household in the MATLAB function. Relevant when electricity tax applies.
data_description.snap_eligible: Matches SNAPEligible: electronically measured quarter-hourly quantities are read by the grid operator.
data_description.eeg_tax_exempt: Matches EEGTaxExempt. Affects electricity tax only; the EEG grid discount still applies. Requires qualifying renewable EEG energy and fulfilled exemption conditions.

abort.already_configured: A tariff profile with these settings is already configured.
